authority.rule: The imported REG-002 v0.1 package is the authority for the nine entities, their fields, required flags, enums, primary keys, unique constraints and foreign keys. This overlay only maps short names to package entities and adds CLOUD-1a vocabulary, extensions and invariants. Every addition is listed in reg002_reconciliation.json; none changes a package file.

provenance.source: REG-002 package (verified import, see cloud/contracts/provenance/reg002_package_manifest.json); BMS-ARC-REG-001 v0.1; BMS-ARC-ENT-001 v0.1; owner decisions OD-1/6/8
provenance.supersedes: registry_mvp.json at f30cbae (hand transcription from document text); differences are recorded in reg002_reconciliation.json

vocabulary_provenance.commercial_provider: CLOUD-1a extension X03 per OD-8; the package keeps commercial_provider a free string
vocabulary_provenance.assignment_source_type: CLOUD-1a extension X02, values from ENT-001 §6

derived_rules.isolation: derived, not stored: ApplicationInstance.workspace_uuid null = shared platform runtime, set = isolated (package conditional_invariants)
derived_rules.reactivation: derived: a workspace with closed_at is reactivated only by an audit event action cloud.workspace.reactivated, target the workspace, occurred after closed_at; status must no longer be closed
derived_rules.manual_grant_reason: derived: AuditEvent.reason of an audit event targeting the assignment

invariants.text: every registry object id is unique within its collection
declared unique keys are unique
every internal reference and every extension key resolves

invariants.source: package invariant 'exactly one active Primary WorkspaceCompanyLink'; CloudWorkspace.primary_company_uuid note
invariants.text: at most one active primary link per workspace; exactly one for provisioning/active/degraded/suspended/closing; primary_company_uuid, when set, equals it
a company referenced by a workspace-scoped object is actively linked to that workspace; a company is active primary in at most one workspace; audit workspace matches target workspace

invariants.source: package immutable primary keys; package invariant 'workspace_uuid is immutable'; overlay immutable_extension (X07)
invariants.text: immutable fields are never changed by a mutation

invariants.source: package invariant 'must not cascade-delete ... historical Registry records'; REG-001 §47
invariants.text: registry records are never deleted

invariants.source: package invariant 'All Control Plane mutations create AuditEvent records'
invariants.text: every registry object has at least one audit event targeting it
audit events are never updated or deleted

invariants.source: package invariant 'Repeated ... triggers must be idempotent'; extension X04 request_hash
invariants.text: one idempotency scope key never carries different request content
a repeated trigger with the same scope key yields exactly one resulting object

invariants.source: package invariant 'Closed Workspace cannot create a new ProvisioningJob until explicitly reactivated'
invariants.text: no job created after closed_at unless an audited reactivation precedes it

invariants.source: package invariant 'ERP ApplicationInstance requires workspace_uuid and a BMS Company link before activation'
invariants.text: an ERP instance beyond draft has a workspace and the company of its active primary link
derived isolation is allowed by the application definition
no two non-retired isolated instances for the same workspace and application

invariants.source: package external_references provider_environment key provider_type + provider_environment_id
invariants.text: an isolated provider environment is used by one instance
a suspended or closed workspace keeps its links and audit history

invariants.source: package invariant 'No raw secrets are stored in Registry'; credential_reference note; extension X08 secretref form
invariants.text: no secret-like keys or private key material; credential_reference is a secretref:// reference
every SubscriptionReference has provenance with an audit event about it; manual_beta requires manual_registration
every assignment has source_type and every job has handler and request_hash
commercial_provider and source types use the CLOUD-1a vocabularies
unknown entitlement or bundle code is rejected (fail-closed)
a commercial_subscription assignment grants only a code contained in the subscription's product bundle
jobs and provisioning entitlements reference a declared handler
manual_admin_grant and support_override have an audit event with a reason
an effective entitlement has all dependencies effective
the Moodle cloudmap projection agrees with the registry via WorkspaceCompanyLink and the status mapping
a Moodle snapshot contains exactly the effective mgmt.* codes of its workspace

clarifications.detail: REG-001 §60 uses 'Not Provisioned'; the package application_instance_state has no such value. v0.1 uses 'draft' and maps it to cloudmap 'not_provisioned'. Needs REG v0.2 decision.

The package allows shared mgmt/academy with workspace_uuid=null and does not forbid a workspace-bound mgmt instance. OD-1 requires isolated spaces, so v0.1 allows mgmt with a workspace. Needs REG v0.2 confirmation.

The f30cbae transcription authored link_status [active, ended] and actor_type incl. 'operator'. The package defines link_status [active, closed] and actor_type [user, service, system]; v0.1.1 uses the package values (operators act as 'user').
OD-8 manual registration is modelled by extension X01 (provenance) and vocabulary X03 (commercial_provider manual_beta); the package fields stay unchanged.
MIG-001 §6 (Requested..Closed) and ENT-001 §5 (Pending..Revoked) differ. v0.1 keeps the package entitlement_state for assignments and application_instance_state for operations (ENT-001 §26).
The package keeps CloudCustomer.status and SubscriptionReference.commercial_status free strings; v0.1.1 no longer restricts commercial_status (f30cbae did).
Hire product and hire.* codes remain OPEN (OD-6); no canonical code is assigned.

The package requires EntitlementAssignment.entitlement_code (one code per row). f30cbae allowed a bundle_code alternative; v0.1.1 drops it, expands bundles into one assignment per code, and checks them against SubscriptionReference.product_bundle_code (INV_BUNDLE_SCOPE).
The package exchange schema uses format uuid/date-time/uri. The CLOUD-1a validator asserts these formats (fail-closed) although Draft 2020-12 treats format as annotation by default.
